input.conventions: Labelled vertices 0..5. Edges are distinct unordered triples. A K4^3 has all four triples of a four-set. Complete family, no isomorphism quotient.
input.scope: New all-family cardinality and conditional-completion index; no previous cyclic construction replay.

scope: All labelled simple K4^3-free hypergraphs on the supplied vertex set; no asymptotic or novelty claim.
